newsitem.title: CHINA: China Eastern Airlines to buy air firm.
newsitem.headline: China Eastern Airlines to buy air firm.

text.p: Hong Kong-listed China Eastern Airlines, one of China's largest airlines, will buy debt-ridden China General Aviation to increase air routes and boost its number of pilots, the Business News said on Thursday.
China General Aviation has 70 aircraft and flies over 40 routes but is suffering from high debts with a debt to asset ratio of 100 percent, the newspaper said.
China has more than 20 airline companies but only six of them are considered large-scale, with five registering losses in 1996, it said.
China Eastern declined to give details of the deal.
China General Aviation was set up in 1989 in Taiyuan, the capital of central Shanxi province,
